known_findings.summary: The submodule calls seaborn.utils._default_color directly. With seaborn 0.13.2 + Matplotlib 3.10.8, Axes.plot.__name__ is wrapper, _default_color returns None, and high-level plotting fails at to_rgba(None). Native package-root harness: 102 passed / 48 failed; a harness-only compatibility resolver restores 150/150.

modelplot advertises feature_importances and x_estimator but never consumes x_estimator. Estimator-only calls render nothing; with x/y supplied, different estimator feature_importances produce the same confusion-matrix image.
decileplot accepts and validates weights, but plot_decileplot discards the extracted _sw and calls compute_decile_table without weights. Weighted and unweighted decile tables are identical.
decileplot exposes hue_order, hue_norm, and palette but calls p.map_hue() without forwarding any of them, so caller semantic mapping configuration is silently ignored.

The supplied accumulated archive lacks scikitplot/__init__.py and scikitplot.externals._seaborn. Direct pytest therefore imports this submodule as top-level seaborn and shadows the installed dependency; package-root harness evidence is required for this snapshot.
